title: Registration Open for the Release of the 10th Edition of Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026 (IP 2026)
bodyHtml:
Registration Open for the Release of the 10th Edition of Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026 (IP 2026)
The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) is pleased to announce that registrations are now open for the official launch of the 10th Edition of the Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026 (IP 2026).

📅 Date: 2nd January 2026
📍 Venue: Dr. Ambedkar International Centre (DAIC), 15 Janpath, New Delhi

IP 2026 marks a major step forward in strengthening India’s drug quality ecosystem. The new edition brings updated standards, enhanced monographs, and improved guidance to support manufacturers, regulators, testing laboratories, academia, and the research community.

Who should attend?
QC/QA professionals, Regulatory Affairs personnel, CRO scientists, pharmaceutical industry professionals, academicians, and students.

To register, scan the QR code on the flyer or click on the links below:

Industry: https://forms.gle/cjJd7o75KqozWUvd7 (opens in a new tab)
Academia/Govt officials: https://forms.gle/KnmUtLBHKb9MhWeE8 (opens in a new tab)
Students: https://forms.gle/bZrCWgWvJTtoZFDc6 (opens in a new tab)

Registration Deadline: December 25, 2025
Seats are limited and will be allotted on a first-come, first-served basis.

For queries, kindly contact: Tel.: 8299462619; Email: lab.ipc@gov.in
